## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible change and link the issue if available.

## Verification

List commands, results and remaining limits. For graphics changes include the applicable actual-browser evidence.

## Compatibility and sources

Describe API/compatibility impact, source or dependency use and AI assistance.

## Review readiness

- [ ] Focused changes with necessary tests and English code comments.
- [ ] English/Chinese documentation ready, or translation assistance requested.
- [ ] No credentials, unauthorized assets or private discussions.

Drafts may start in either language. Maintainers complete bilingual review and current metadata before Main integration. [中文模板](pull_request_template.zh-CN.md).
